import heapq
import sys

def main():
    # Max heap for the lower half (store negatives)
    max_heap = []
    # Min heap for the upper half
    min_heap = []
    
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    
    for _ in range(n):
        line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
        parts = line.split()
        
        if parts[0] == 'addNum':
            num = int(parts[1])
            
            # Add to appropriate heap
            if not max_heap or num <= -max_heap[0]:
                heapq.heappush(max_heap, -num)
            else:
                heapq.heappush(min_heap, num)
            
            # Balance heaps
            # max_heap can have at most one more element than min_heap
            if len(max_heap) > len(min_heap) + 1:
                moved = -heapq.heappop(max_heap)
                heapq.heappush(min_heap, moved)
            elif len(min_heap) > len(max_heap):
                moved = heapq.heappop(min_heap)
                heapq.heappush(max_heap, -moved)
        
        else:  # findMedian
            if len(max_heap) > len(min_heap):
                # Odd number of elements
                median = -max_heap[0]
                print(f"{float(median):.1f}")
            else:
                # Even number of elements
                median = (-max_heap[0] + min_heap[0]) / 2.0
                print(f"{median:.1f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
